notes: Republican county committee was on the June 2, 2026 primary ballot in all 618 election districts (one contest per district, 'Vote for 2'); the June 10, 2025 primary had no county committee contests. Each contest lists two slots plus a write-in line; a slot with no candidate is printed 'No Petition Filed'. The results do not say which slot is the male or female seat, so seats are labeled 'Member' rather than Committeeman/Committeewoman. Filled = a named candidate whose vote total exceeds the district's write-in total (every named candidate did). Empty = 'No Petition Filed' slot and zero write-in votes in the district. Unknown = 'No Petition Filed' slot in a district where write-in votes were cast (write-in winners are not named; the county's write-in names PDF is on a site that blocks automated requests). No privacy suppression appears in the Clarity contest totals. No contest had more than two named candidates. District names are the contest suffix as printed (e.g. 'Monroe W1 D5' = Ward 1 District 5). The source prints three Old Bridge contest names twice ('Old Bridge W1 D10', 'Old Bridge W3 D1', 'Old Bridge W4 D8', Clarity contest keys 0379/0380, 0390/0391, 0405/0406), each pair with different results; the second of each pair is kept as a separate unit with '(second contest, Clarity key …)' added to its name, since the source does not say which district it is.
